scope: Bounded explicit name/address labels, name punctuation boundaries, contact corroboration. No learning, telemetry, user data collection, updates or model downloads. Do not introduce general name gazetteers or fixture-specific substitutions.
singleCandidate: mSuperClinical selected before these runs because it has the stronger name-only result in the previous comparison. Current pair is the regression control. No pack migration implied.
criteria: Use unchanged meetsScreeningFloor. Fixes must not introduce new request errors; inspect lost complete entities and new ordinary masking, including category-only coverage. Evaluate old fixtures as regressions. Fresh 32-case synthetic holdout frozen before fixes, inspect only after policy and focused tests are complete. If thresholds fail, no model promotion.
limits: Same developer authored scenarios; synthetic and not representative field accuracy. No automatic real-world feedback. Baseline copied to ignored artifacts before code edits; hashes reported. Native and WASM hosted by developer Node adapter; no fresh packaged-app claim.
